Car guides

Mobile service or workshop visit?

Choose the setting that suits the job, not just the distance.

LEKKI LIFE / 3 MIN READ

Start with an honest description

Tell the team whether the vehicle starts, moves and stops safely. Give an accurate location and describe access to the vehicle. The technician can then assess whether a mobile visit is appropriate.

Prepare a suitable working area

A level, accessible parking area away from moving traffic is more useful than a roadside location. The team must decide whether the work can be performed safely with the available space and equipment.

Some jobs need the workshop

Repairs requiring lifting equipment, extended dismantling or specialist facilities may need a workshop visit. A mobile assessment can still help establish the next step, subject to availability.

Confirm the details

Ask about the visit charge, expected scope, parts and arrival window. Do not assume that a requested time is confirmed. If a vehicle cannot be moved safely, ask about appropriate recovery arrangements.
